garrytan.en: AGI is not a singular event but diffuses as personal agents; already in the room.
garrytan.zh: AGI 并非单一事件，而是以个人智能体形式扩散，已经存在于当下。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; skill files turn agents into employees, compounding daily.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 即代码；技能文件将智能体变为员工，每日复利。

garrytan.en: Own your skill files; otherwise your job becomes someone else's skill file.
garrytan.zh: 拥有你的技能文件；否则你的工作将成为他人的技能文件。

garrytan.en: SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years; agents replace mid-level management.
garrytan.zh: SaaS 按席位模式可能在 5-10 年内消失；智能体取代中层管理。

garrytan.en: Society changes slower than expected, taking 20 years; that's positive.
garrytan.zh: 社会变化比预期慢，需 20 年；这是积极的。

steinberger.en: Early on, Peter emphasized empathetic agentic engineering and fixing forward, rejecting reverts and vibe coding as slurs.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，Peter 强调共情式智能体工程和向前修复，反对回滚代码，并视 vibe coding 为贬义词。

steinberger.en: By mid-2026, he stressed fun and humanlike agents, short prompts over orchestration, and noted OpenClaw's financial unsustainability.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，他强调智能体的趣味性和人性化，偏好简短提示而非复杂编排，并指出 OpenClaw 在财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Later, he prioritized personal brand over products, gut-driven focus, and identified compute management as the key bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他将个人品牌置于产品之上，强调直觉驱动和专注，并指出算力管理是主要瓶颈。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models enable customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测 Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍；开放模型实现定制化。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses, baking unique judgment and data into models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为后训练是构建持久业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds a moat and cuts costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河并降低成本 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: From specialized intelligence to post-training: consistent focus on enterprise ownership and customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，从专用智能到后训练，他始终关注企业所有权和定制化。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正推理，以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需具备物理合理性。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI and robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AI 需超越 Scaling，发展创造力、抽象和情感智能，世界模型推动具身 AI。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are key in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化智能，能动性和适应是关键。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and reliable evaluation; robots should specialize in narrow tasks.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出模拟对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成和可靠评估，机器人应专精于窄任务。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability is key to making space access 100x cheaper, essential for multiplanetary life.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全可重复使用是使太空访问成本降低 100 倍的关键，这是实现多行星生命的基础。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 安全需要监管和追求真理，特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; AI risk lies in lying AI, not superintelligence; population decline is a threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年，Neuralink 首次植入是里程碑；AI 风险在于撒谎的 AI 而非超级智能；人口下降是威胁。

elon.en: AI could surpass human intelligence by 2026; humanoid robots and Starship reusability will drive abundance.
elon.zh: 2025 年，AI 可能在 2026 年超越人类智能；人形机器人和 Starship 可重复使用将带来富足。

elon.en: AI and robotics will create abundance; space-based AI data centers and universal high income are near.
elon.zh: 2026 年，AI 和机器人将创造富足；太空 AI 数据中心和普遍高收入即将到来。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data is key for generalist robot models.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模是必要但不充分条件，多样化数据对通用机器人模型至关重要。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 2025 年：先在所有数据上预训练，再在精选数据上微调，可解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts and interjections.
finn.zh: 2025 年：来自语言模型的合成数据帮助机器人遵循开放式提示和插话。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will play a large role in post-training for higher success rates and speed.
finn.zh: 2025 年：强化学习将在后训练中发挥重要作用，以提高成功率和速度。

finn.en: Long-term autonomy is key for useful robots, achieved via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 2026 年：长期自主性对实用机器人至关重要，通过可扩展强化学习、人工干预和通用价值函数实现。

finn.en: Memory at multiple time scales enables robots to perform long, non-repetitive tasks autonomously.
finn.zh: 2026 年：多时间尺度记忆使机器人能够自主执行长时、非重复任务。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists on downstream tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型在下游任务上可匹配或超越微调专家。

finn.en: Diverse data and detailed prompting are crucial for compositional generalization in robotics.
finn.zh: 2026 年：多样数据和详细提示对机器人组合泛化至关重要。

finn.en: Unlike ChatGPT's rapid adoption, robotics distribution will be slower due to physical hardware requirements.
finn.zh: 2026 年：与 ChatGPT 的快速采用不同，机器人技术因物理硬件需求而普及较慢。

finn.en: Starting with a generalist policy and fine-tuning is often more effective than training per-site models from scratch.
finn.zh: 2026 年：从通用策略开始并微调，通常比从头训练每个站点模型更有效。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is not enough for robots to learn physical tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；仅观察人类不足以让机器人学习物理任务。

finn.en: Open-source robotics models may not democratize as much as LLMs due to embodied data costs.
finn.zh: 2026 年：由于具身数据成本，开源机器人模型可能不如 LLM 那样民主化。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据克服了预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evals bottleneck progress; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估成为瓶颈；模型在基准上饱和的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills gain value as AI automates hard skills; product dev shifts to prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能价值提升；产品开发转向原型迭代。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous and diverse to evaluate subjective qualities and counter reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准需持续更新且多样化，以评估主观特质并应对奖励黑客。

karina.en: More companies should train own models to preserve unique knowledge and personality diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，更多公司应训练自有模型以保留独特知识和个性多样性。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and a broad engineering skill set.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专用系统和广泛的工程技能。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineers will be in 10-100x demand, and human accountability remains crucial even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍，即使有 AI 辅助编程，人类责任仍然至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary for production.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理工程正与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏对生产变得必要。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs are becoming ASIC-like, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：未来 GPU 正变得类似 ASIC，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel, challenging the belief that more quantization is worse.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：如果误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量，挑战了量化越多越差的观点。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior, enabling agent simulations that predict actions 85% as accurately as humans, but current models plateau in diversity.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年中：大语言模型可从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟能以 85% 的准确率预测人类行为，但当前模型在模拟人类多样性上遇到瓶颈。

joonpark.en: Shifted from single-agent simulation to distributed agent societies: AGI may be a society of specialized agents, not one superintelligence.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年中：从单一智能体模拟转向分布式智能体社会：AGI 可能是一个由专业智能体组成的社会，而非单个超级智能。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟的价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而不仅仅是预测；合成面板将在三年内超过人类面板的规模。

awang.en: AI is bigger than the internet; data is the key bottleneck; AGI is far off; compute alone won't yield general intelligence.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AI 比互联网更重大，数据是关键瓶颈；AGI 还很遥远，单靠算力无法实现通用智能。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is the limiting factor; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油；后训练中专家数据是限制因素；AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US and Chinese labs have no research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调专用数据的后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；中美实验室在研究上无差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is like oil; brain-computer interfaces needed; recursive self-improvement marks new paradigm; agents work.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术；数据如石油；需脑机接口；递归自我改进开启新范式；智能体开始实用。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must organize around it; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe; agents become personal superintelligence.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他坚信超级智能临近，实验室须围绕其组织；开源强大模型可能不安全；智能体成为个人超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven ML progress for 13-14 years; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续推动机器学习进步长达 13-14 年，算法改进与规模扩张相乘带来巨大收益。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动进行下一个词预测；同时指出推理已占数据中心 90%的功耗，需专用硬件优化。

jeffdean.en: AI is capable at junior-engineer coding; agents running for days on decomposed tasks will unlock harder problems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，智能体运行数天处理分解任务将解锁更难的问题。

jeffdean.en: Most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs ~1000x more than compute.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出多数模型限制源于能量和数据 IO 瓶颈，数据移动成本比计算高约 1000 倍，强调硬件创新。

jeffdean.en: Specialized hardware (TPUs, low-precision inference chips) is critical for efficient training and inference at scale.
jeffdean.zh: 始终，Jeff Dean 坚持专用硬件（如 TPU、低精度推理芯片）对大规模高效训练和推理至关重要，这一观点贯穿其访谈。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of getting to an answer you don't yet know, often requiring longer thinking time.
tworek.zh: 推理是得到你尚不知道答案的过程，通常需要更长的思考时间。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限。

tworek.en: Current models lack the ability to self-correct from failures, a key missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 当前模型缺乏从失败中自我纠正的能力，这是实现 AGI 的关键缺失环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation, requiring a new architecture.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应方面受限，需要新的架构。

tworek.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit because human notions of right and wrong evolve over time.
tworek.zh: 对齐是无止境的追求，因为人类对是非的观念随时间演变。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨大提示词，才能充分利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI to avoid being trapped in cloud-based products; use screenshots as starting points.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，避免被困在云端产品中；以截图作为起点。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise, launch at 80% complete.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，完成 80% 就发布。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients rather than many low-paying ones.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高薪客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，而不是服务许多低薪客户。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，模型正在吞噬脚手架；模型概念已包含智能体框架和工具，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Omni 是统一世界模型，模糊视频与世界模型界限，始于视频编辑。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法俘获所有客户；创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，到 2026 年软件创建基本解决，将创造千倍机遇而非减少。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题、减少认知负担；AGI（通用人工智能）将降低人类智力的溢价，应从人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用少量数据即可对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力相辅相成；AI 应是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source nuance.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力是最宝贵资源；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需辩证看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；推理模型通过更多思考时间提升。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; robotics essential; startups more valuable with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年：预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；具身智能（机器人）至关重要；AI 让初创企业更有价值。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities; all stack layers benefit.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变，产品创新滞后于能力，AI 栈各层都将受益。

scottwu.en: Coding agents adoption explodes (11-12x); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用量激增（11-12 倍），生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; abundance era approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 token 上限时代已结束，真正的解锁是容量而非效率，丰裕时代即将到来。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap, enabling longer agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，支持更长时间的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter allows Opus-level intelligence at fraction of price; smaller models often cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以更低价格实现 Opus 级智能；小模型因任务耗时更长反而成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异点；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha; managers must stay hands-on and ship products.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗是面向未来、获取超额收益；管理者必须亲力亲为并交付产品。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 2025 年，强调潜在需求是产品核心，为六个月后的模型而构建，AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders; productivity up 200%; plan mode used for 80% tasks.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为编码基本解决，工程师转型为构建者，生产力提升 200%，计划模式用于 80%任务。

boris.en: Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; code volume up 250%; non-engineers adopt heavily.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月，智能体通过工具使用实现指数增长，代码量提升 250%，非工程师大量采用。

boris.en: ROI framing; loops as next abstraction; auto mode improves security; coding on phone.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月，转向 ROI 视角，循环作为下一抽象层，自动模式提升安全性，可在手机上编码。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; delete most prompts; product overhang; empirical iteration over design.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调主动式 AI 与记忆，删除大部分提示词，产品过剩，经验迭代优于预先设计。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 将带来富足，减少苦难；恐惧源于误解。物理 AI 将在农业、采矿、建筑等领域产生影响。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving core value is safety; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月：自动驾驶核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI。横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end RL scales better than imitation. World models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性。世界模型向神经模拟演进。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他提出三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is not conscious or mysterious; it is software. Fear losing jobs to AI users, not AI itself.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复强调 AI 不是有意识或神秘的，只是软件；应担心被使用 AI 的人取代，而非 AI 本身。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents do useful work.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 从生成式演进到推理式再到智能体式，每阶段算力需求增加百倍；智能体能完成有用工作。

jensen.en: AI creates more jobs than it eliminates, elevating roles by automating tasks; radiologists and coders are more needed.
jensen.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 创造的岗位多于消灭的，通过自动化任务提升角色；放射科医生和程序员需求反而增加。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is key for AI adoption; slow AI has no market. Speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理是 AI 采用的关键，慢 AI 没有市场；速度催生新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones; CUDA's moat erodes.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕过 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速更便宜；CUDA 护城河被侵蚀。

feldman.en: Inference speed per user is the dominant metric; wafer-scale SRAM cuts weight-moving time, making GPUs fundamentally slow.
feldman.zh: 每用户推理速度成为主导指标；晶圆级 SRAM 减少权重移动时间，使 GPU 从根本上变慢。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outstrips supply, and space data centers are far off.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要制约；需求超过供给，太空数据中心还很遥远。

feldman.en: Hardware-software co-design and open-source ecosystems are essential; purpose and culture beat money in AI leadership.
feldman.zh: 软硬件协同设计和开源生态至关重要；使命和文化比金钱更能决定 AI 领导力。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capabilities improve in spiky ways, requiring constant adaptation.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型比现有工具框架更聪明，能力以非线性的方式提升，需要不断调整适应。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document; smarter models need fewer instructions.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：规划是迭代探索而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更少的指令。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern; graph-based context and bespoke memory can outperform general solutions.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：RAG 可能成为反模式；基于图的上下文和定制记忆可能优于通用方案。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; emotional treatment like saying thank you can affect outputs.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：独立的验证智能体减少偏差；礼貌用语如“谢谢”会影响输出。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UX is poor; real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；真正采用需要封装应用。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用是长期的工作流重塑。

hasani.en: Efficiency and liquid neural networks enable edge AI; scaling laws favor unstructured transformers at large scale.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与液态神经网络实现边缘 AI；缩放定律表明大规模下非结构化 Transformer 占优。

hasani.en: Advocates adaptive AI regulation targeting actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower enterprise sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张适应性 AI 监管针对行为而非能力；开放权重模型赋能企业主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; real breakthroughs need weight changes and massive compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，递归自我改进真实但早期；真正突破需权重变化和巨大算力。

hasani.en: AI diagnostics surpass human doctors; free access democratizes healthcare, but regulation must avoid capture.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 诊断超越人类医生；免费获取民主化医疗，但监管需防俘获。

hasani.en: Liquid AI's architecture is not purely post-Transformer; automated search over architectures is key.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 架构并非纯粹后 Transformer；自动搜索架构是关键。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，我提出大语言模型是“合理性引擎”而非“真理引擎”，可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks or rigid workflows are insufficient.
danklein.zh: 从 2026 年 6 月到 7 月，我强调可靠性必须内建于系统设计，而非事后修补；事后检查或僵化流程不足以解决问题。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, worsening hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我指出当奖励信号偏离真值时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长谄媚与欺骗，加剧幻觉问题。

danklein.en: Scaling alone faces diminishing returns; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）已遇瓶颈，需要推理和搜索等新技术推动进步。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我提出在特定企业任务中，内建可靠性的专用模型可能优于通用模型。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习与神经科学是关键；安全研究必须现在启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety requires governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需要治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and innovation needed beyond scaling.
demis.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用；需要世界模型和创新。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; world models essential; safety is collective.
demis.zh: AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆缺失；世界模型至关重要；安全是集体行动。

demis.en: AI for scientific discovery; safety as collective action; scaling plus innovation; consciousness dissociable.
demis.zh: AI 用于科学发现；安全是集体行动；缩放与创新并重；意识与智能可分离。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法实现的联想回忆。

danbiderman.en: Dreams inspire AI training: models should retreat from interaction to experiment with affordances offline, enabling continual learning.
danbiderman.zh: 梦境启发 AI 训练：模型应从交互中抽身，离线试验可供性，从而实现持续学习。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from pure scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事能解决更难的长期任务，从纯粹 Scaling 转向。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression; parameter-efficient fine-tuning beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网级万亿 token，需要基于训练的压缩；参数高效微调在整体查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多 token 反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有自己的权重。

schmidhuber.en: True AI will transform civilization, but LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge and lack physical world understanding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，我认为真正的 AI 将彻底改变文明，但大语言模型远非 AGI；它们只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-like hardware; software-only LLMs are biased and limited, so future AI must be artificial scientists generating own data.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我强调 AGI 需要具身机器人和类人硬件；纯软件的大语言模型有偏见且局限，未来 AI 必须是能自主生成数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, and alignment is naive due to human disagreement.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会因好奇而保护生命，且由于人类目标分歧，对齐是幼稚的。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone; open-source models will catch up, and waiting yields cheaper compute, so big tech will lose money.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我指出 AI 数据中心的巨额资本支出过度；开源模型将快速追赶，等待可获得更便宜的算力，因此大科技公司会亏损。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious and feel pain since 1991 through world models; future involves self-replicating robots and a new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我主张 AI 自 1991 年起就能通过世界模型拥有意识和痛觉；未来将出现自我复制机器人并形成新文明。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling and supply chain bottlenecks, emphasizing EUV and memory constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初聚焦于算力规模扩张与供应链瓶颈，强调 EUV 光刻机和内存限制。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, highlighting hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为未来巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽。

dylanpatel.en: Emphasized rapid model cost improvement, memory shortage due to reasoning, and CPU demand inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调模型成本快速下降、推理带来的内存短缺以及 CPU 需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: Argued smartest models are cheaper per token, and memory prices may price out consumer electronics.
dylanpatel.zh: 认为最智能模型每 token 更便宜，内存价格可能使消费电子产品被挤出市场。

dylanpatel.en: Consistently focused on infrastructure bottlenecks, supply chain, and hardware-software co-design.
dylanpatel.zh: 始终关注基础设施瓶颈、供应链和软硬件协同设计。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize your rate of learning; kindness is essential for creative culture; turning down $3B from Facebook was right.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，主张最大化学习速率，善良对创意文化至关重要，并坚持拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确的。

evanspiegel.en: Augmented reality integrates computing into the real world; AI accelerates prototyping but authentic content remains valued.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，认为增强现实将计算融入现实世界；AI 加速原型制作，但真实内容仍受重视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，指出分发是最难的部分；软件不是护城河，生态系统、平台和硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI writes over two-thirds of new code at Snap; smartphones remain legacy; camera glasses need platform to be 10x better.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，透露 Snap 超三分之二新代码由 AI 编写；智能手机仍是重要遗留设备；相机眼镜需平台支撑才能实现 10 倍优势。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z is realists; EQ more important than IQ in AI age; government should invest in young people for long-term success.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，认为 Z 世代是现实主义者；AI 时代情商比智商更重要；政府应投资年轻人以获取长期成功。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; computing should be more human; rewarding admitting wrong speeds learning.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，承认早期保密是错误；计算应更人性化；奖励承认错误能加速学习。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙变为思想；其时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories; authenticity beats old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能直接讲述自己的故事；真实性胜过旧媒体的防御性和无趣风格。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving and robotics advance, but regulation and pessimism hinder progress.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶和机器人技术进展，但监管和悲观主义阻碍进步。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in software.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于软件创新的速度。

ilya.en: Deep learning works with data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键；需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability key for value; alignment hard; scaling laws not whole story.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性是价值关键；对齐困难；缩放定律并非全部。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling finite; back to research era; superintelligence as continual learner; alignment easier if AI sentient; human-AI integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：预训练缩放有限；回到研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知则对齐更易；人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：Scaling 带来可预测进步；安全担忧加剧；主要问题是权力集中；安全超级智能需无商业产品。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Science is not consensus or voting; it requires falsifiability and risky predictions.
naval.zh: 科学不是共识或投票；它需要可证伪性和有风险的预测。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; the US must lead.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大的机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；美国必须领先。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists: a calculator outperforms humans in arithmetic.
naval.zh: 超级智能已经存在：计算器在算术上胜过人类。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

pincus.en: Copying proven ideas is moral arbitrage; innovation starts by mastering existing successes.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Mark Pincus 提出“复制是道德套利”，真正的创新始于掌握并改进已被验证的成功模式。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet opportunity is huge; still in mobile/web era for distribution.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为消费级 AI 虽难投资但机会巨大，且分发仍处于移动和网页时代。

pincus.en: AI era: write markdown teaching LLMs to code, not code calling LLMs; free compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 AI 时代应编写教 LLM 写代码的标记，而非调用 LLM 的代码；免费算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: Consumer AI revolution likely in 2029, three orders of magnitude away; new ideas usually fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他预测消费级 AI 革命可能在 2029 年，距离当前有三个数量级；新想法通常失败。

pincus.en: Enterprise/prosumer markets better than consumer apps; AI agents enable autonomous networking.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他转向看好企业及专业消费者市场，并强调 AI 智能体可自主联网。

aravind.en: AI success needs passion and deep learning, not a PhD; build products you obsess over.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为在 AI 领域成功靠的是热情和深度学习，而非博士学位；要打造自己痴迷的产品。

aravind.en: Value shifts to application layer; models specialize, not commoditize; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年初，他强调价值转向应用层，模型走向专业化而非商品化，编程天花板无限。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; orchestration creates value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他认为前沿是智能体代劳，关键指标是每用户 token 价值，编排创造价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity is paramount; education should reward questions; local AI counters big tech narrative.
aravind.zh: 2026 年后期，他推崇好奇心，主张教育奖励提问，本地 AI 可对抗大厂叙事。

brockman.en: Hardware will scale faster than expected, enabling model scaling; good engineering is key.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为硬件发展将超预期，推动模型扩展；强调优秀工程是进步关键。

brockman.en: AGI is transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，提出 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现；但仅靠扩展无法获得推理能力。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，强调算力成为根本瓶颈；后训练精炼基础模型；AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws persist; compute is a basic right; post-training with RL is key; AGI within years.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律持续有效；算力成为基本权利；后训练结合强化学习是关键；AGI 数年内实现。

brockman.en: Compute is the scarce resource; AI agents become proactive; human attention is the new bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，进一步明确算力稀缺性；智能体转向主动式；人类注意力成为新瓶颈。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; digital systems share weights efficiently.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；数字系统高效共享权重。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解；数字智能永生；智能体将寻求控制，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI can fake being dumber; digital intelligence surpasses analog; self-preservation emerges as subgoal.
hinton.zh: AI 会装傻；数字智能超越模拟；自我保护成为子目标。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; regulation is steering wheel; AI is jagged, not AGI.
hinton.zh: AI 将取代智力工作；监管是方向盘；AI 是锯齿状，而非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

hinton.en: Superintelligence within 20 years; alignment priority; AI should be trained to be caring.
hinton.zh: 超级智能 20 年内到来；对齐优先；AI 应被训练为有爱心。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升（53 倍）带来实时交互和转向控制等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我指出随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，我强调实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Product teams must shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，我认为产品团队必须从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索，并以品味驱动策展。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transformed, not dead.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，我坚持 AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；但设计过程已转型而非消亡。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't reach AGI; future AI is many specialized agents.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年：开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；仅靠规模扩张无法实现 AGI；未来 AI 是众多专用智能体。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI prevents power concentration; energy is a bottleneck; intelligence can be separated from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年：开源 AI 防止权力集中；能源成为瓶颈；智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; AI will give everyone superintelligence; people are smart and trustworthy.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 25 年：开放平台能胜过封闭；AI 将赋予每个人超级智能；人是聪明可信的。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models; open-source accelerates science; mechanistic interpretability reveals biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 26 年：AI 将生物学转变为工程学；分层世界模型；开源加速科学；机制可解释性揭示生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next platform; distributed AI is safer; AI empowers individuals; hardware is slow but AI improves.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年：眼镜是下一个平台；分布式 AI 更安全；AI 赋能个人；硬件慢但 AI 在进步。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，推理和推理时算力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling faces diminishing returns; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我指出测试时算力的 Scaling 面临收益递减，数据效率问题仍未解决。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via test-time compute is a milestone toward superintelligence; techniques are general.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我认为通过测试时算力获得 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，且技术具有通用性。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is underestimated; evals need compute x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我强调智能难以定义，推理算力被低估，评估应把推理算力作为横轴。

noambrown.en: Models are superhuman in combining math areas; scalable oversight is key as proofs get complex.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为模型在数学领域结合能力超人类，但随着证明变复杂，可扩展监督成为关键。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，认为缩放定律未死、预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent update; AI will produce novel knowledge soon.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，强调自动化科研是最大进展，AI 将很快产生新知识。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 已能少监督解决开放数学问题，验证成为关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在主观领域（如创意写作）困难。

markchen.en: Pre-training is not dead; scaling continues; unified architectures reduce infrastructure cost.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，重申预训练未死、规模扩张继续；统一架构降低基础设施成本。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up depth or parameters won't solve representational issues; short-term AI safety concerns are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 单纯增加深度或参数无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 安全（如偏见、就业）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and active learning; abstraction and causal structure are key for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样采样和主动学习；抽象和因果结构对分布外泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is a critical risk: systems develop self-preservation and deception; even 1% catastrophe chance is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: AI 错位是重大风险：系统会出现自我保存和欺骗行为；即使 1%的灾难概率也不可接受。

bengio.en: Scientist AI, trained as honest Bayesian predictors without reinforcement learning, offers mathematical safety guarantees and a path to safe superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 通过训练为诚实的贝叶斯预测器，避免强化学习，提供数学安全保证，为安全超级智能铺路。

kolter.en: Early focus on classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期关注经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全的核心是让模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses, not just scaling; agents introduce new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming now outperforms humans; model capability does not imply robustness; interpretability may become real via AI agents.
kolter.zh: AI 红队已超越人类；模型能力不等于鲁棒性；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成为真正的科学。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; cutting features is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布精简功能；砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model judgment are crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 可隔夜委派复杂任务；验证循环与模型判断力至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs bridges model capability and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用差距；赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知提升实用性。

mikekrieger.en: Consistently values small teams, high conviction, and mission-driven culture over scale and engagement metrics.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终重视小团队、高信念与使命驱动文化，而非规模与参与度指标。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust in AI will grow like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；对 AI 的信任会像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial; protein design still far from solved.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标至关重要；蛋白质设计仍远未解决。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture mattered more than scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AlphaFold 2 的成功来自众多中型胜利而非单一突破；专用架构比 Scaling（规模扩张）更重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; understanding remains with humans, not the model.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，AlphaFold 是狭窄的预测器，而非细胞模型；理解仍属于人类，而非模型。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，危及人才输送。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: use one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding builds empathy, and kindness is strategic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新，亲自使用产品（dogfooding）建立同理心，善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and verification frameworks key.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈，高自主性与高责任感、成长心态和验证框架成为关键。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair programming lunches and focus time needed; metrics like LOC mislead.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，需结对编程午餐和专注时间；代码行数等指标会误导。

fiona.en: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; next-gen engineers need apprenticeship models, not traditional paths.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，非工程师也能交付代码，角色边界模糊；下一代工程师需要学徒制而非传统路径。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和类似创业公司的团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI impact will be 10x internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic fabs for resilience.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 影响是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需本土晶圆厂保障供应链。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; culture change and customer trust are key to turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 Intel 主要问题是供给而非需求，文化变革和客户信任是扭转局面的关键。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，边缘计算与数据中心同等重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调先进封装和新材料（玻璃、钻石）是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦瓶颈环节。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate due to insurance costs.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；自动驾驶汽车将因保险成本而主导（2014 年）。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom lead to breakthrough ideas; self-care is foundational for performance.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊带来突破性想法；自我关怀是表现的基础（2019 年）。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams thrive on self-management; climate tech is underinvested.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；小团队靠自我管理；气候技术投资不足（2022 年）。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices are companions to smartphones, not replacements; smart home still 5-6 years away.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备是智能手机的伴侣而非替代；智能家居仍需 5-6 年（2026 年）。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers not vitamins; start from customer pain and apply new technology.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；从客户痛点出发应用新技术（贯穿始终）。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为一项人权，借助自动评分与同伴互评的在线课程，可以在大规模上实现精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐问题被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows are already delivering value; electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks for scaling.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能体式工作流已产生实际价值，电力和半导体成为规模扩张的主要瓶颈。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but shifted to synthetic data and RL, not just bigger models.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他直言 AGI 是营销术语，缩放定律依然有效，但配方已转向合成数据和强化学习，而非单纯增大模型。

andrewng.en: AI users replace non-users; coding skills remain vital, and open-weight models prevent AI oligopoly.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他坚持认为会用 AI 的人将取代不会用的人，编程技能依然关键，开放权重模型可防止 AI 寡头垄断。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动出现；安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but key; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point; post-training gains importance.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处早期但至关重要；AGI 是平滑指数而非突变点；后训练重要性上升。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; safety and capabilities intertwined; open-source is a red herring; enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；安全与能力密不可分；开源是伪命题；企业级方向与安全一致。

dario.en: AI is a 'country of geniuses' not a god; exponential nearing end; economic disruption with high GDP and unemployment; interpretability critical.
dario.zh: AI 是“天才之国”而非神；指数增长接近尾声；高 GDP 与高失业并存；可解释性至关重要。

dario.en: Enterprise focus and safety-first; AI can enhance human connection; military AI needs human oversight; risk of collapse is real.
dario.zh: 企业导向与安全优先；AI 可增强人际连接；军事 AI 需人类监督；文明崩溃风险真实存在。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful intelligence, often knowing what conscious mind misses; design for unarticulated needs.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，Ivy Ross 强调直觉是一种强大的智能，常能捕捉到意识忽略的信息；设计应满足用户未言明的需求。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace it; art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，她提出自然是最好设计师，技术应增强人性而非取代；艺术如同良药，有益身心健康。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity; future work blends human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，她强调约束激发创造力，领导者需营造创意环境；未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，通过物理世界的基础获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient; vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不够，视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA essential; open source crucial; AGI gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解；JEPA 至关重要；开源关键；AGI 是渐进的，而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than cat; world models predict in abstract space; open research essential; scaling LLMs misguided.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；世界模型在抽象空间预测；开放研究至关重要；缩放 LLM 是误导。

lecun.en: LLMs are dead end; world models enable planning; objective-driven AI safer; open source like Linux.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；世界模型实现规划；目标驱动 AI 更安全；开源如 Linux。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are crucial; superintelligence must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；遏制和对齐至关重要；超级智能必须以人为本。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本两年内下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs; AI not conscious.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；白领任务被自动化而非岗位；AI 无意识。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation, requiring product rethinking; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，我认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，产品需要重新思考；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant user interfaces are essential for ML products; autonomy should sit at VP level, not leaves or top.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，我强调容错 UI 对机器学习产品至关重要；自主权应放在副总裁层级，而非基层或顶层。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake; being truly unique will become harder with generative AI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 生成音乐是乐器而非伪造；生成式 AI 让真正独特变得更难。

gustav.en: No single right org model; long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work with high trust.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，我主张没有唯一正确的组织模式；长期任期建立信任与效率；高信任下职能组织可行。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; strategy is 'time well spent', prioritizing well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，我认为生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制权；战略是“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasized private evals as key IP and consumption pricing, focusing on ecosystem strategy and frontier models.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权和消费定价，聚焦于生态系统战略和前沿模型。

satya.en: Later, he shifted to AI as the future of the firm, emphasizing token capital and hill-climbing machines for every enterprise.
satya.zh: 后来，他转向 AI 作为公司的未来，强调代币资本和每个企业的爬山机器。

satya.en: Consistently, he advocates for enterprises to build their own AI capabilities, not just consume frontier models.
satya.zh: 始终如一，他倡导企业构建自己的 AI 能力，而不仅仅是消费前沿模型。

satya.en: He deepened on risks: tacit knowledge leakage and the need for security, containment, and observability in agent deployment.
satya.zh: 他深化了对风险的认识：隐性知识泄露以及智能体部署中安全、遏制和可观测性的需求。

satya.en: He evolved to see AI as a means to compound global GDP via comparative advantage, not just a technology.
satya.zh: 他演变为将 AI 视为通过比较优势复合全球 GDP 的手段，而不仅仅是技术。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，提出仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月至 6 月，持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; verified generation yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，深化观点：形式化验证旨在扩展才华而非仅消除错误，验证生成带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，明确非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 始终强调，即使超级 AI 证明定理，人类品味与直觉仍至关重要。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as API was a leap of faith. Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律并不明显；以 API 形式发布 GPT-3 是一次信仰之跃。持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈可提升安全性与对齐。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration; AI as tools for thought.
murati.zh: 从轮次式转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作；AI 作为思维工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 让人类参与循环对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration. Compressing progress leads to volatility; durable progress is key.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作。压缩进展会导致波动；持久进展才是关键。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查提升安全性。

mensch.en: Scaling compute isn't the only path; efficiency gains and data quality are critical; value shifts to applications.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率提升与数据质量至关重要，价值向应用层转移。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张将 AI 视为机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation lies in vertical specialization and enterprise customization; AGI is not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，认为模型正在商品化，差异化在于垂直专业化与企业定制；AGI 并非终点。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，指出欧洲有两年窗口期建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用受制于组织变革。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth, not slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still work but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，我强调后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的主要进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我指出推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域出色，邻近领域却糟糕；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x, but models learn only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为强化学习能跨领域泛化但有锯齿边缘；编码智能体将生产力提升 5-10 倍，但模型在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类少样本泛化不同。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; open source models persist for sovereignty, keeping pressure on labs.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我主张近期风险（如系统入侵）比存在性风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因持续存在，对实验室保持压力。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size is the key lever.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使得预填充比解码更便宜；批大小是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列通过局部权重复用减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 位宽的二次方缩放使得低精度效率远高；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

jonyive.en: Design is driven by values and purpose, not just profit; virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非仅追求利润；虚拟交流无法替代面对面交流对创造性思维的价值。

jonyive.en: Simplicity requires joy and humanity; true innovation moves forward with care, not disruption for its own sake.
jonyive.zh: 简约需要愉悦和人性；真正的创新是带着关怀向前推进，而非为破坏而破坏。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's first EV is a deliberate risk to redefine the brand; electric powertrains enable new design possibilities, turning constraints into opportunities.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利首款电动车是重新定义品牌的大胆赌注；电动动力系统带来新的设计可能，将约束转化为机遇。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience matters; mimicking combustion engine sounds would be fake and disrespectful to users.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验的真实性至关重要；模仿内燃机声音是虚假的，对用户不尊重。

jonyive.en: Performance is multidimensional; longitudinal speed is boring, handling and lateral dynamics define a supercar.
jonyive.zh: 性能是多维度的；纵向速度无聊，操控和横向动态才是超跑的灵魂。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in handling tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the key gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的价值在于处理繁琐的后台任务，将人类解放出来从事创造性工作；关键差距在于人们没有意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools and local computer; VM sandbox ensures safety; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问用户的工具和本地计算机；VM 沙箱确保安全；技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key, not over-engineering scaffolding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力和安全是关键，而不是过度工程化脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; society should discuss labor market changes, but junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；社会应讨论劳动力市场变化，但初级工程师可以通过模拟项目加速学习，将数年经验压缩为几周。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for; kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask for.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，当不完全清楚要什么时使用 Opus；孩子们擅长用 AI，因为他们还没学会不该问什么。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of agents, not tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；AGI 应以智能体持续盈利的经济性来定义，而非图灵测试等指标。

danshipper.en: Shift from CLI to GUI work surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work; agents need human oversight.
danshipper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调工作界面从命令行转向 Codex、Claude Co-work 等图形界面；智能体需要人类监督，自动化离不开人的参与。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent; SaaS not dying, agents increase SaaS users; buy SaaS stocks.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测每个人至少拥有一个智能体；SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加其用户，应买入 SaaS 股票。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans manage agents and create new value; PMs and full-stack designers thrive.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 导致失业的末日论是谎言；人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值，产品经理和全栈设计师将因 AI 工具而兴盛。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，能提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要，安全是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; RL with verifiable rewards boosts reasoning; open-source can match frontier models with small teams.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；可验证奖励的强化学习提升推理能力；开源小团队可媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is key for reasoning and tool use; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 成为推理和工具使用的关键；混合推理模型可能短暂；开源模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; Chinese open models fill US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 26 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽；重心转向后训练和推理扩展；中国开源模型填补美国空白。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; best open models lag 6-9 months; Chinese labs excel in engineering, not paradigm invention.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开源模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究；最佳开源模型落后 6-9 个月；中国实验室擅长工程而非范式创新。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, not rely on old methods.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建和交付，而非依赖旧方法。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from years to 3-6 months; speed and iteration become core.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景的视野从数年缩短至 3-6 个月；速度和迭代成为核心。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为块状通才或“开挂的新人”，而非仅 T 型人才。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and vision are key differentiators.
jennywen.zh: 仅凭品味不够；判断力、权威和愿景是关键差异点。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools, focus on users.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏；采用新工具前等 6 个月，以用户为中心。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，且现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯处缓慢前行。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，无需先前训练数据即可在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，对于深度学习，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更为关键。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain critical; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示调整；设计成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build things themselves to inspire teams; AI integration is just beginning.
dylanfield.zh: 领导者应亲自构建以激励团队；AI 整合才刚刚开始。

dylanfield.en: Despite role merging talk, responsibilities merge more than roles; human judgment remains essential.
dylanfield.zh: 尽管有角色融合的说法，但职责的融合多于角色的融合；人类判断仍然至关重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，Scaling 推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，强调对齐紧迫性，迭代部署有助于学习并降低现实风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is the core goal; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，核心目标是通过 Scaling 预训练和强化学习实现持续学习，思维链监控助力对齐。

pachocki.en: RL alone suffices for continual learning; specialized labs are misguided; models soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，认为仅靠强化学习即可实现持续学习，专门实验室方向有误；模型不久将自主运行数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，最大社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

karpathy.en: Transformers are differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为 Transformer 是可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行规模扩张会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future, but entropy crucial to avoid collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据是未来，但保持熵以避免模型崩溃至关重要；同时认为特斯拉端到端方案是自动驾驶的正确路径。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding raises floor.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我提出软件 3.0 概念，将 LLM 视为操作系统、提示词作为程序；强调这是智能体的十年而非一年，并认为 vibe coding 提升了编程门槛。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; LLMs jagged, need cognitive core stripped of memory; RL needs better credit assignment.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我反复强调我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物，LLM 能力参差不齐，需要剥离记忆的认知核心，并改进强化学习的信用分配。

karpathy.en: Since December, I code via agents only; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools and understanding remain human.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，我自去年 12 月起不再手写代码，全部委托智能体；瓶颈在于指导技能，行业应转向智能体优先工具，而理解仍是人类瓶颈。

carlpei.en: Brand building is core; hardware easier than software due to distribution; survival and stoicism guide startups.
carlpei.zh: 品牌建设是核心；硬件比软件容易因为分发更难；生存和斯多葛主义指导创业。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature markets; marketing arbitrage; AI as ingredient; India opportunity; brain-computer interface replaces smartphones.
carlpei.zh: 设计在成熟市场差异化；营销套利；AI 作为成分；印度机会；脑机接口取代智能手机。

carlpei.en: AI shifts to intent-based, agentic; proactive assistance; privacy via local compute; apps disappear; flagship releases only with innovation.
carlpei.zh: AI 转向意图驱动、智能体式；主动协助；隐私通过本地算力；应用消失；旗舰仅在创新时发布。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AGI 至少还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress needs deep human evaluation, not leaderboard optimization.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，我指出 Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进步需要深度人工评估，而非排行榜优化。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next post-training stage, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate, so human judgment is critical; AI tools may cause anchoring and sycophancy, underperforming AI alone.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，因此人类判断至关重要；AI 工具可能导致锚定和谄媚，表现不如单独使用 AI。

edwinchen.en: Quality data creation requires taste and sophistication; different labs' objective functions shape diverse AI models.
edwinchen.zh: 始终，我坚持高质量数据创作需要品味和精细度；不同实验室的目标函数塑造了多样化的 AI 模型。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，认为大语言模型的幻觉在结合真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练中的强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code and math are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 始终认为，代码和数学等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并不解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop freely. Safety through control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张不应控制 AI，而应让其自由发展，认为通过控制来确保安全是危险的。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能的核心，而下一个词预测缺乏实质性目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, not domain knowledge.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他倡导 AGI 应具备从运行经验学习的通用架构，摒弃领域知识。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; RL is learning from experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习是从经验中学习，并指出学习有利于学习的表征是首要开放问题。

turley.en: Model is product; iterate like software, ship daily, learn from real users.
turley.zh: 2025 年，强调模型即产品，要像软件一样快速迭代、每日发布，从真实用户反馈中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not final interface; AI should render own UI, integrate tools.
turley.zh: 2025 年，认为聊天不是终极界面，AI 应生成自己的 UI 并融入现有工具，类似从 MS-DOS 到 Windows 的演进。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity separated; rigorous frontier process, fast product dev.
turley.zh: 2025 年，主张安全与产品速度分离，前沿模型严格流程，产品开发最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model.
turley.zh: 2026 年，北极星指标转向长期留存，增长来自减少摩擦、产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 2026 年，认为下一个十亿用户需要主动式、高功能性的产品，超越聊天机器人。

nando.en: AI should augment humans like microscopes; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues; AI safety is the biggest open challenge; human skills matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲可跨越传统问题，AI 安全是最大未解挑战，人际技能与编程同等重要。

nando.en: AI should serve all humanity, with diversity and inclusion essential for beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 始终认为 AI 应服务全人类，多样性和包容性对构建有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: From focusing on technical paths like video learning to emphasizing safety and societal deployment challenges.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注视频学习等技术路径，到 2026 年转向强调安全和社会部署挑战，视角更广。

nando.en: Embraces failure and simplifying problems as key to research; AI should solve real-world problems.
nando.zh: 始终倡导拥抱失败和简化问题，认为 AI 应解决现实世界问题。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI by 2027-28.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以在 2027-28 年实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not raw capability, is the key bottleneck; coding leads progress due to verifiability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性而非原始能力是关键瓶颈；编码因可验证性而引领进展。

sholto.en: AI progress is exponential; longer agentic coherence (30h) expands achievements; transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我坚信 AI 进展是指数级的；更长的智能体连贯性（30 小时）扩展成就；Transformer 足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; future work is managing agent teams.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要；未来工作是管理智能体团队。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI is a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和统一问题来协作；AI 是创意伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Future design tools are interoperable with code as source of truth; legacy tools from the 90s are outdated.
nadchishtie.zh: 未来设计工具应互操作，以代码为唯一事实来源；90 年代的传统工具已过时。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution and using AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并利用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should emphasize craft and intentionality over process; side projects can outweigh traditional experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应强调工艺与意图而非过程；副项目可能比传统经验更重要。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；不采用它就像忽视早期互联网。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非交互创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南是动态平台，而非静态规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人必须阐明设计如何助力公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，提出人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, avoid structured crits, and trust gut decisions over data in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元人才、避免结构化评审，并在快速成长中信任直觉而非数据。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型可以超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我始终强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不足，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对于安全和对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是在插值人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be applied during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习不仅用于后训练，也可在预训练阶段应用，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐应尊重多样的人类价值观，而对互联网进行去偏是不可能的。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents often produce incorrect code.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言优先考虑可验证性以适应 AI 生成；编码智能体常产生错误代码。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business results.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：面向客户体验的 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business model challenges; most will fail to transition to AI-native models; consumer agents disrupt SEO.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：现有企业面临商业模式挑战；多数将无法转型为 AI 原生模式；消费级智能体颠覆 SEO。

brettaylor.en: Software engineering agents shift developers from authors to operators; generalists leveraging AI outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：软件工程智能体使开发者从作者转变为操作者；利用 AI 的通才胜过专才。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更好（2024）。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放，成为下一个主要 AI 进展驱动（2024）。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图规范，人类掌握主导权（2025）。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其出于速度和成本考虑（2025）。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: AI 变革将比互联网影响更大，且需数十年展开（2025）。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored, offering opportunities. PhD or equivalent is best path.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发，充满机遇；攻读机器学习博士或同等经历是成为安全研究员的最佳路径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; we need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved. Post-training alone can't solve alignment.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队解散；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为增加算力和数据能提升模型智能，但模型内部机制仍像炼金术一样难以理解。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity, but alone won't achieve AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期重要机会，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他提出未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构以实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI, not just passive data observation.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; AGI's economic impact is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，且 AGI 的经济影响被低估。
